item.title: Paraguay's president is impeached minutes after resigning following a bank collapse
item.description: Paraguayan lawmakers voted to impeach President Santiago Peña minutes after his resignation, as the collapse of a digital bank tied to his government froze millions of people's savings.

item.title: Russell Brand is convicted of rape, and judge says he'll get a prison term
item.description: A prosecutor described Brand as a ruthless, calculating, manipulative "sexual predator." Brand, 51, denied the charges, saying he had never forced anyone to do something against their will.

item.title: What's next for Democrats after the midterms. And, a look at the outstanding races
item.description: Democrats have regained control of Congress. They have a long list of investigations into Trump planned. And, not all races have been called. Here's a look at how they could affect the Dems' majority.

item.description: On Morning Edition, Pulitzer Prize-winning historian Anne Applebaum breaks down what a Democratic Congress could change about Trump's foreign policy and what remains beyond its power.

item.title: Hong Kong activist Joshua Wong is sentenced to 10 more years in prison
item.description: Wong was sentenced for his second conviction under a Beijing-imposed national security law, in a case that critics say reflects the crackdown on the city's once-thriving pro-democracy movement.

item.title: Japan faces diplomatic dilemma amid joint pressure from nuclear neighbors
item.description: As the Ukraine war grinds on, ties between Russia and neighboring Japan are at their worst in decades. Tokyo wants more support from Washington, but some Japanese are concerned they may not get it.
